channel.title: Zone3 guides
channel.description: Question-shaped buyer guides from both desks of this site: the four /guides/ pages and the Air Fryer Field Notes buying guides. Working titles; every quoted listing title is checked on the date shown; no price, rating or review count is reproduced and no traffic or ranking claim is made.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function claims are easy to count and hard to test. Ask what each number refers to and what is in the box.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Dishwasher-safe wording is in two of the three titles. Counter space is in none of them. Here is how to check both.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity numbers on listings can measure different things. Check what the number measures before you compare two.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Start with the form, then check what the title says about compartments, presets and accessories.

item.title: What “4-in-1” actually names — and what a listing leaves out
item.description: Counted claims read closely, the temperature that is worth checking, and a two-minute test you can run on any listing.

item.title: Dual-basket vs single-basket: which layout suits how you cook?
item.description: Two 3QT baskets are not one 6QT with a divider — what the layout changes at dinnertime, and when the single big basket wins.

item.title: Which air fryer parts actually go in the dishwasher — checked line by line
item.description: The claim is about a basket, not a machine. What each listing states, and the one place the care section beats the title.

item.title: 6QT, 8QT and 26QT: what the capacity numbers do and do not tell you
item.description: The quart figures quoted from each listing, the ratios shown as our arithmetic, and the four checks to run before you pick.

item.title: Air fryer oven vs basket fryer: the 26QT is not a bigger basket
item.description: What doors, a convection cavity and six included accessories change — and why Amazon files this machine under Air Fryers, not Air Fryer Ovens.
